purpose: Held-out evaluation set for the mid-size training run. Every task here was authored AFTER the model was trained, so it cannot have leaked into training -- a guarantee a corpus carve-out cannot make.

requires: task.json validates against the current schema
at least 1 reject fact with validation_status == CERTIFIED
selection_bar.reject_shaped_rule: polarity == 'reject' OR statement contains one of ¬ ∉ ≠
selection_bar.why: Below this bar a task cannot demonstrably refute a vacuous `def VTask.X _ := True` candidate: its reject fact returns UNKNOWN and drops out of fidelity's denominator.

disjointness: Computed by diffing the current manifest against the training snapshot recovered from git, not asserted. Verified zero overlap by name.
scoring_notes: Score only facts with scoring_safe == true (validation_status CERTIFIED). A PROVISIONALLY_VALIDATED fact was never kernel-confirmed against ground truth; 84 of 466 facts here fall in that category.

Fidelity is near-vacuous on this corpus: FAIL is nearly unreachable on forward facts and UNKNOWN leaves the denominator, so a `:= True` candidate scores ~1.000. Separation against mutant suites is the signal that survived scrutiny.
n_certified_reject > 0 on every task by construction (the T3 bar), so every task here can demonstrably refute a vacuous candidate.

facts.statement: ∀ (k : Type*) (V₁ : Type*) (P₁ : Type*) [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module k V₁] [AddTorsor V₁ P₁] (S₁ S₂ : AffineSubspace k P₁) [Nonempty ↥S₁] [Nonempty ↥S₂] (h : S₁ = S₂), Function.Bijective (VTask.ofEq S₁ S₂ h)

¬ ∀ (k : Type*) (V₁ : Type*) (P₁ : Type*) [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module k V₁] [AddTorsor V₁ P₁] (S₁ S₂ : AffineSubspace k P₁) [Nonempty ↥S₁] [Nonempty ↥S₂] (h : S₁ = S₂) (x : ↥S₁), (↑(VTask.ofEq S₁ S₂ h x) : P₁) ≠ (↑x : P₁)

∀ (k : Type) (V₁ : Type) (P₁ : Type) [Ring k] [AddCommGroup V₁] [Module k V₁] [AddTorsor V₁ P₁] (S₁ S₂ : AffineSubspace k P₁) [Nonempty ↥S₁] [Nonempty ↥S₂] (h : S₁ = S₂), S₁ ≠ S₂ → VTask.ofEq S₁ S₂ h ≠ (VTask.ofEq S₁ S₂ h).symm.symm → False

tasks.name: Localization.liftOn
tasks.signature_type: {M : Type u_1} -> [CommMonoid M] -> {S : Submonoid M} -> {p : Sort u} -> (x : Localization S) -> (f : M → ↥S → p) -> (H : ∀ {a c : M} {b d : ↥S}, (Localization.r S) (a, b) (c, d) → f a b = f c d) -> p

facts.statement: ∀ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {S : Submonoid M} (x : Localization S) (k : ℕ), VTask.liftOn x (fun _a _b => k) (fun _h => rfl) = k

∀ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {S : Submonoid M} {p : Sort*} (x : Localization S) (f g : M → ↥S → p) (Hf : ∀ {a c : M} {b d : ↥S}, Localization.r S (a, b) (c, d) → f a b = f c d) (Hg : ∀ {a c : M} {b d : ↥S}, Localization.r S (a, b) (c, d) → g a b = g c d), (∀ a (b : ↥S), f a b = g a b) → VTask.liftOn x f Hf = VTask.liftOn x g Hg

∀ (a : ℕ) (b : (⊤ : Submonoid ℕ)) (f : ℕ → (⊤ : Submonoid ℕ) → ℕ) (H : ∀ {a c : ℕ} {b d : (⊤ : Submonoid ℕ)}, Localization.r ⊤ (a, b) (c, d) → f a b = f c d), VTask.liftOn (Localization.mk a b) f H = f a b → VTask.liftOn (Localization.mk a b) f H ≠ f a b + 1
